description_expanded:
Highland Park, a quiet community in Blue Mountain Beach

1.1 miles to the Blue Mountain Beach Access

Resort-style lagoon pool (heated seasonally), cabana(!), hot tub, firepit, grilling area, etc

3 bedroom, 2.5 baths

Six-seater golf cart!

Gas grill

3 bikes

Outdoor shower

4-star restaurants

Fun, yummy eateries

Come Sail Away by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Discover Come Sail Away, an enchanting 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom beach house nestled in the Highland Parks community, in Blue Mountain Beach. This tranquil retreat offers easy access to a tropical lagoon-style pool, perfect for families and friends. Explore the neighborhood with a complimentary six-seater golf cart. Spend leisurely days at the community pool! Other neighborhood amenities include a soothing waterfall, a seasonally heated hot tub, an observation tower, a cozy gas fire pit, and a pavilion complete with barbecue grills and a snack bar. Bordering Point Washington State Park, you’ll love the peaceful walking trails and Florida's coastal wildlife. After a day in the sun, relax in luxury.

The thoughtfully decorated home features warm coastal decor, plush seating, and a large TV. The modern gourmet kitchen, with breakfast bar island, invites guests to indulge in culinary exploration. Choose Come Sail Away at Highland Parks for a perfect blend of relaxation and adventure, creating unforgettable fun and beach vacation memories. Enjoy! Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 1.1 miles to the beach (Blue Mountain Beach Regional Access) - Backs up to resort pool and cabana (heated seasonally) - 3 bedroom, 2.5 bath - 1705 sq ft - Outdoor shower - Wi-Fi - Natural gas grill - 3 Bikes - Complimentary golf cart (Only 1 golf cart per property per strict HOA rules, please do not rent a second cart.) Overnight: - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom; private bath; TV - King in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath; TV - Two twin over twin bunks in 2nd floor guest room; shared bath; TV - Queen sleeper sofa in the 1st floor living room Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
